claim: Patchline ships a compliance evidence export mapping gate results to common audit frameworks. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the compliance export claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make compliance-evidence-export-gate`.
